declared.name: list_active_agents
declared.description: List Singularry agents currently marked active on the platform (max 100). Returns nfaTokenId, erc8004AgentId, slyWalletAddress, riskProfile and persona name for each. Public — no authentication required.

declared.name: get_agent_portfolio
declared.description: Get an agent's currently-open strategy positions as the Singularry runtime reports them: per-position strategy, cost basis, mark-to-market value and unrealised PnL. This is the runtime position book, NOT a raw on-chain token scan. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <privy access token>` of the agent OWNER. A public ratios-only tier exists but is DISABLED during beta; other callers get an authentication error.

declared.name: get_agent_strategies
declared.description: Get an agent's active strategy commitments and allocation capacity (per-strategy allocated capital, portfolio mode, free capital, risk budget). Additionally requires the account to have AI-Agent access, mirroring the dashboard route this proxies. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <privy access token>` of the agent OWNER. A public ratios-only tier exists but is DISABLED during beta; other callers get an authentication error.

declared.name: get_agent_pnl
declared.description: Get an agent's PnL summary for one window: realised PnL, unrealised PnL, total return %, and open/closed position counts. Some fields are null when the runtime suppresses an untrustworthy number — null is never zero. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <privy access token>` of the agent OWNER. A public ratios-only tier exists but is DISABLED during beta; other callers get an authentication error.

declared.name: get_recent_decisions
declared.description: Get an agent's recent autonomous-loop allocation decisions from the runtime feed (cycle number, strategy, action, reason, timestamp). This is the RUNTIME feed only — narrower than the dashboard activity feed, which additionally merges chatbot-side exit and maintenance rows. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <privy access token>` of the agent OWNER. A public ratios-only tier exists but is DISABLED during beta; other callers get an authentication error.
